root_contract_audit.label_vocabulary: 13 foreground CoW classes: IDs 1..12 and 15. The actual case label contains 11 nonzero values, omitting 8 and 15. Different taxonomy from TopBrain v1 despite identical source image bytes.
root_contract_audit.aggregation: Dice/B0/HD95 average only foreground classes present in each GT case, then cases. clDice merges all nonzero labels into a binary vessel mask. Group-2 detection and anterior/posterior topology have separate aggregates; this is not TopBrain union-of-GT-and-prediction class averaging.
root_contract_audit.geometry: SimpleITK nearest-neighbor resamples shape mismatches to the GT physical reference; metrics then unconditionally copy GT metadata to the prediction. An array score is not independent affine validation.
root_contract_audit.submission: The preparer sample includes image_id,modality,predicted_mask_path. The grader explicitly requires image_id and predicted_mask_path, and does not validate modality.
